title.narrative: Strengthening PRSP Monitoring and Evaluation Framework

description.narrative: The main purpose of the project is to create an in country M&E capacity and to strengthen the PRSP M&E framework, by making it more result focused. Therefore the grant will be funding training sessions intended to provide a Leadership team composed of staffs from public administrations playing a pivotal role in the PRSP implementation monitoring and evaluation with basic knowledge in result oriented monitoring and evaluation and especially in the PRSP M&E framework design and implementation. Once trained, the team members are also supposed to be training other staff members involved in the PRSP M&E. The project will also contribute in mainstreaming knowledge transfers between International Consulting firms specialized in M&E and Local consulting firms which will be acting as the first one assistant during the project implementation. As regard to Mali PRSP M&E framework strengthening, the project will provide support to the PRSP coordinating unit when addressing its current weakness as recommended by the Government when approving Mali PRSP2 commonly named Poverty Reduction and Growth strategy Paper (PRGSP 2007-2011) in December 2006. As a result, the grant will fund the development of a Pilot Results Matrix aiming at translated part of the PRGSP Policy Matrix into a comprehensive M&E framework capable of providing decision makers with relevant standardized reports on the PRGSP implementation progress toward its final outcomes achievement.
